finding.behavior: Error state contains only Text; identical failed query cannot be explicitly retried on the Native standalone/embedded source-search surface. Query onChange is the only search action; initial task only refreshes associations.
finding.counterpart: Anytype/Sources/Pinkha/Torah/UI/TorahSourcesSearchView.swift existing error ButtonData uses Loc.Pinkha.Home.retry and await presenter.performSearch().

T6: Preserve narrow historical physical-iPad search-icon/association-strip PASS; it is not broad current-product acceptance.
Use existing editor/RTL/Native23/source-drag/AX plans only after actual matching shared products are admitted.
Mixed App/OS language both directions, iPhone/iPad/light/dark, list/title/quote/selection, keyboard, gestures, VoiceOver/DynamicType and visual inspection remain scope-specific runtime obligations.
Multiple-window/Stage Manager/offline and physical-device observations have no new acceptance from this bounded source read.
anchors: Retain original preparation/mounted/linked-ui1PASS each, original collection failure and original linked-native enumeration timeout.
Expired original fixture cannot resume; unchanged7200s lifetime requires all six original preparation/mounted/linked-ui/linked-native/unlinked-ui/unlinked-native stages on a fresh owned fixture.
Six-stage Page154 control and typed collector already exist; runtime/source/common producer pins remain closed until separately qualified.

Original linked-ui replaces the marked text and cold-reopens; no before/after/partial mixed-RTL/emoji/split-merge/copy-paste/Undo anchor UI acceptance is inferred. Such cases are not mapped to a mounted selector in the bounded existing six-stage handoff; this does not prove missing production behavior.
InspectorSearch: Current Heart and Native hosts both inject the optional same-panel search capability, use fixed document association context for embedded search and navigate through supplied navigation.navigateToFullSource.

Existing inspector-search-only selector testInspectorEmbeddedSearchOpenReturnAndDocumentLink covers Open/Back/query/result retention/no-write/explicit Link/previous links. Current matching-product execution remains required.
Topic/Word use accepted typed management capability from the earlier G03 audit; no reader-page extension or new misrouting claim.
Controlled provider-error fixture and actual Retry recovery remain required; no empty-result substitution or new controller/suite introduced.
